# Latchi Watersports Centre

> The largest watersports and boat hire company in Cyprus, in Latchi (Latsi) harbour on the edge of the Akamas Peninsula. Family-run since 1978. Self-drive boat hire with no boat licence needed (car licence, 21+), private yacht charters, PADI 5-Star diving, watersports and RYA courses.

- Address: Latchi Harbour, Latchi, Polis Chrysochous, Paphos District, Cyprus
- Phone: +357 26 322 095 · WhatsApp: +357 96 603 611
- Email: info@latchiwatersportscentre.com
- Open daily 08:00 to 20:00 in season
- Prices in EUR, no hidden fees

## Boat hire FAQ

- Do I need a boat licence? No. In Cyprus, visitors can drive our boats with a valid car driving licence. The driver needs to be 21 or over, and everyone gets a full briefing and basic training before leaving.
- I've never driven a boat. Is that OK? Most of our guests haven't. The briefing covers everything, our team can take you for a short practice run, and our safety boat patrols the coast all day.
- What happens if there's swell? When the sea is up, we send the boats out with one of our captains at the helm, so you still get your day on the water. For changes and refunds, see our refunds and cancellations policy.
- How far is the Blue Lagoon? About 6 nautical miles west of Latchi along the Akamas coast. Allow around 35 minutes each way in a smaller boat and longer if you stop at the coves.
- Can we bring food and drink? Yes. Every boat has a cool box, so bring lunch, drinks and ice. Please take all your rubbish back with you. The Akamas is a nature reserve.
- How long can I hire a boat for? Most guests take 4 hours, either 09:00 to 13:00 or 14:00 to 18:00. That's plenty for the Blue Lagoon and a couple of coves. You can also book 1 or 2 hours, or a full day of 6 hours.
- Is fuel included? No. You leave with a full tank and we refuel when you're back, so you only pay for what you used, at the market rate. Just like car hire.
